notes.title: My Free Zoo - Partner Zoo
notes.content:
From now on, your zoo will be even clearer - without any compromises! The brand new partner zoo is now available in the game and gives you the opportunity to outsource animals without sacrificing experience points or visitors. Quite the opposite: you get all the bonuses as usual - just with more freedom and better performance.

🏞 How the partner zoo works:
	You can reach it via a new building next to your main zoo	It is divided into region areas – from grassland to jungle to ice.	You can donate animals as soon as you have at least two specimens in the main zoo or in a region.
https://upportal.wavecdn.net/news//images/0514_2025_MFZ_partner_zoo_640_250.jpg

This gives you more overview, reduces loading times and at the same time gives you the opportunity to continue collecting experience points and visitors - all automatically.

🎁 And that's not all:

You will receive progress points for caring for the animals in the partner zoo, which you can use to gradually unlock exclusive rewards - including new employee vouchers and special enclosure decorations. Your own employees at the partner zoo will also help you to automatically collect XP pins.

notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the Halloween-Events starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

My Little Farmies

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From October 22nd to 29th the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the Shrunken head-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new „Saddler‘s“ production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

My Free Zoo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect Lionhead tokens at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive Siberian musk deer to exhibit in your zoo. (The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.)

My Free Farm

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The Halloween card-matching game is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. (October 22nd 
through to November 5th.)

But also your  Horse Farm (24 – 30 October), Wauies (24 – 31 October), My Sunny Resort (23 – 30 October) and My Free Farm 2 (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Start of the 2018 Christmas Event
notes.content:
Decorate your zoo, collect snowflakes and win cute Chamois

Are you too dreaming of a white Christmas? The world of My Free Zoo already is covered under a cozy blanket of snow dotted with seasonal decorations everywhere.​

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/ab5998d37e9ec5db0a455256e20fb67500fd5295.jpg

Between December 5 and 19, you may decorate zoo with Christmas decorations - ranging from a nativity scene to the frozen lake, complete with ice skaters, you will find many elements that create a festive ambiance.

Every decoration placed adds to your „snowflake score“, which is added up at the end of the event and exchanged for a rare animal.

This year, next to the Sable and the European Sturgeon, we are introducing the Chamois to the Zoo. The first of these rare animals can be yours for only 20,000 snowflake points.

We hope you enjoy a wonderful Christmas season and wish you success decorating.

notes.title: Menagerie and Alaska Day Event
notes.content:
A new region and 24 hours Alaska Day event

Good news for zoo directors with an extensive circle of friends: The Zoological Society has opened up a new region: the Menagerie.

Of course you will have to own the Zoological Society and fulfill a few tasks to unlock this new region.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/69e28bc6270a70faffc6ef9f99494069e3367a8b.jpg

After this, it will offer all the challenges and amenities the normal zoo offers, but will grant you full friendship stars for completed tasks, giving you access to valuable rewards quicker.

In honor of the new region we will be celebrating Alaska Day on October 18th.

For 24 hours, breeding times and costs will be halved for many animals typical for the Americal polar region, like the American Black Bear, Kodiak bears, Bold Eagles, Narwhales and the like. On top of this, every successful breeding completed within that period will reward the proud parents with twins.

We wish you a a lot of fun with the new Menagerie and the Alaska Day celebrations!

notes.title: World Cup Event
notes.content:
Dear Zoo Directors,

"In Soviet Russia, country comes to you!" Football fever is rampant in the zoo, and you can now get a closer look at the World Cup's host country in this year's World Cup Event! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/e8c35a2e2918737d58c3664e73f92a975a872a7f.jpg

For the duration of the event, you'll find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with impressive Russian landmarks and international banners - use them to show your enthusiasm for your team and this year's enchanting host country!

Each World Cup decoration you place in your zoo will give you points in the form of Footballs at regular intervals. Just click on the pin that appears above them to collect your Footballs.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/f6042565c36e54a7b1d02782a4c8738d9a43263e.jpg

One special decoration - the King's Gate - will instantly give you 7,500 Footballs when you charge it for 10 Diamonds.

You can click on this icon at the right side of your playing field to see your progress. Collecting enough Footballs before the event ends on July 11 at 10:59 am CEST will allow you to earn 3 awesome animals for your zoo!

You can also help out your friends by sending pieces of two exclusive World Cup friendship gifts!

Prizes include two former prize animals, the Arapaima and the Kea, as well as a brand-new animal, the Raccoon Dog!


50,000 Footballs - Arapaima
100,000 Footballs - Kea
200,000 Footballs - Raccoon Dog
400,000 Footballs- Arapaima
600,000 Footballs - Kea
750,000 Footballs - Raccoon Dog

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/cbd3fc9e10da3c614d2f7891623469760ce75869.jpg

While bearing an uncanny resemblance to raccoons, the Raccoon Dog is actually a canine. Native to Eastern Asia - its Japanese name (tanuki) is also quite popular - it was introduced to parts of the Soviet Union between 1928-1958. It is now abundant in large parts of Eastern Europe. Raccoon Dogs are good fathers, helping the females raise their litters. In your zoos, these furry bandits will feel most comfortable in forest and ice enclosures, where they take up six fields of space and can be kept in groups of ten.

Enjoy the game!

Your My Free Zoo Team

notes.title: Zoological Time Traveling!
notes.content:
The Natural History Museum and the Zoological Society have teamed up to create a place for all those Museum animals you've brought back from extinction: the all-new Prehistoric Park region!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/3023975004b06ce8cddf4da07d2f6dcc3ba83160.jpg

The Prehistoric Park is a brand-new region that allows you to created mixed species exhibits in a magnificent prehistoric setting.

In addition to allowing you to create unique enclosures with mixed communities of extinct animals, the Prehistoric Park will attract significantly more visitors. There are also special decorations for your Prehistoric Park (some for enclosures, some for outside) as well as themed stalls so your visitors can enjoy a real blast from the past!

Unlocking the Prehistoric Park

To gain access to the Prehistoric Park, you must have a Zoological Society in your zoo. This building grants you access to regions with special properties, such as the the Zoo d'Amour, the Serengeti, and the new Prehistoric Park.

To unlock the Prehistoric Park, you must first complete some prerequisite tasks:

- Breed 10 Dodos
- Breed 10 Woolly Mammoths
- Breed 10 Smilodons
- Breed 10 Ankylosaurus
Note: You can skip this task for 290 Diamonds (or less, if you've already completed some of it), but this will only skip the prerequisite. You will not get any baby animals, nor will you get credit for achievements that involve breeding these animals. You are only paying to skip the prerequisite!

Once these tasks are complete, you can unlock the Prehistoric Park for either 40,000,000 ZD or 175 Diamonds.

Expanding and Populating the Prehistoric Park

Your Prehistoric Park starts out with a size of 20x20 fields with a number of obstacles that need to be removed to make room for enclosures. Some of these cost Diamonds to remove.

Of course, there are also a number of expansions for the region unlockable for either Zoo-Dollars or Diamonds. Animals in the Prehistoric Park require special Prehistoric Park enclosures, which can be purchased in the shop while in the Prehistoric Park. While regular space limits apply, there is no herd limit within Prehistoric Park enclosures, allowing you to keep impressive herds of mammoths!

At time of release, the Prehistoric Park can be home to the following species:
Haast's Eagle, Moa, Quagga, Giant Ground Sloth, Thylacine, Woolly Rhinoceros, Dodo, Glyptodon, Triceratops, Ankylosaurus, Bear Dog, Deinotherium, Terrorbird, Woolly Mammoth, Quetzalcoatlus, Smilodon, Paraceratherium, Tyrannosaurus

Breeding in the Prehistoric Park

As breeding in mixed species enclosures is too stressful for the animals, breeding animals in the Prehistoric Park requires special breeding enclosures, in which you can only keep a single species. These can be purchased in the shop and outfitted with prehistoric breeding equipment (watering hole and habitation).

notes.title: Aviary Week
notes.content:
Dear Zoo Directors,

Birds of a feather stick together! Hidden away in your aviaries, your magnificent flying specimens are often overlooked. Time to change that by luring visitors in with images of fluffy owl chicks - and letting them discover for themselves that the most stunning birds tend to have rather hideous offspring. Our Aviary Week is a fantastic ugly duckling teaching moment for visitors' children!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31143502/43b686395251c2d658841bc4ec88337deb397a4c.jpg

From now until April 25 at 10:59 am CEST, selected bird breedings will result in triplets! Every successful 

     Striped Owl
     Galah
     Black-Chested Buzzard-Eagle
     Glittering-Throated Emerald
     Western Crowned Pigeon
     Wilson's Bird-of-Paradise  


breeding completed* before April 25 at 10:59am CEST will grant you triplets!

In addition to extra babies, all players who breed triplets will also receive twice the experience. And if the breeding wasn't successful? Players will receive twice the experience anyway, as a bit of a consolation prize.

Please note: The experience bonus is already calculated into the pop-up display that appears for your information after a successful breeding. You can also find detailed entries with exact exp numbers in the System Log. Just click on the Adviser (the "System log") on the top left!

Enjoy the game!

Your My Free Zoo Team

*Breedings must complete during the event period; breedings that were started during the event will not result in triplets once the event expires.
